rationale: P identifies vehicle braking behavior itself, which must be characterized to evaluate SG-3's goal of preventing unintended braking. H-3 establishes the operating situation and the hazardous occurrence of stopping without an obstacle ahead. Including braking maneuvers within that situation is appropriate to the target; P does not expand into observation, computation, communication, failure-response mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “Braking behavior of the ego vehicle” identifies the behavior directly addressed by the evaluation target.
“Whether braking occurs when no obstacle is present in front” corresponds to H-3's hazardous event.
The scope's straight-ahead urban driving at 50 km/h, good weather, and absence of visible obstacles or vehicles ahead matches H-3's operational situation.
“Including any braking maneuver occurring in that situation” remains within the braking phenomenon addressed by SG-3, rather than adding supporting mechanisms.
